# cliomicplot

# **cliomicplot** _(*Publication-Ready Clinical & Multi-Omics Visualizations*)

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Online Handbook

For an in-depth, chapter-by-chapter guide covering clinical trials,
oncology response tracking, high-throughput omics, and coupled
multi-network architectures (modeled after *circlize_book*), read the
online book:

👉 **[Clinical and Omics Data Visualization in R with
cliomicplot](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot_book/)**

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Quick Start

``` r

# install.packages("remotes")
# remotes::install_github("vanhungtran/cliomicplot")
library(cliomicplot)

# One line = a publication-ready figure
cliplot(Surv(time, status) ~ sex, data = lung,
        type = "km", theme = "nejm", palette = "jama",
        title = "**Overall Survival** by Sex") +
  cli_markdown()
```

That’s it. No
[`ggplot()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/ggplot.html)
boilerplate, no manual
[`theme()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/theme.html)
tweaking, no
[`ggsave()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/ggsave.html) dance.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Why cliomicplot?

**Raw ggplot2** for a grouped boxplot with stats:

``` r

library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
ggplot(ToothGrowth, aes(dose, len, fill = factor(dose))) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  stat_compare_means(method = "t.test", label = "p.format") +
  scale_fill_jco() +
  theme_classic() +
  labs(title = "Tooth Length by Dose", x = "Dose (mg)", y = "Length (mm)") +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

**cliomicplot:**

``` r

cliplot(len ~ dose, data = ToothGrowth,
        type = "boxplot", palette = "jco",
        stat.test = "t.test", title = "Tooth Length by Dose")
```

> **~80% less code.** Formula interface, auto-legends, journal themes,
> and statistical annotations built in.

| What you get for free | Base ggplot2 | cliomicplot |
|----|----|----|
| Formula interface (`y ~ x \| group`) | — | ✅ |
| Auto-legend + auto-facet | Manual | ✅ |
| Statistical annotations | Needs `ggpubr` | ✅ Built-in |
| Journal themes (Nature, NEJM, etc.) | Manual tweaking | ✅ `theme = "nejm"` |
| 55+ colorblind-safe palettes | Manual selection | ✅ `palette = "jco"` |
| Markdown in titles/labels | Needs `ggtext` | ✅ [`cli_markdown()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_markdown.md) |
| Save to file | Separate [`ggsave()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/ggsave.html) | ✅ `file = "plot.pdf"` |
| Persistent global theme | [`theme_set()`](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/get_theme.html) | ✅ `clitheme("nature")` |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Installation

``` r

# From GitHub
remotes::install_github("vanhungtran/cliomicplot")

# Dependencies (installed automatically, but pre-install if needed)
install.packages(c("ggplot2", "scales", "survival", "reshape2", "ggrepel", "ggtext"))

# Optional: richer heatmaps (ComplexHeatmap) and extended survival plotting (survminer)
install.packages(c("ComplexHeatmap", "survminer", "ggpubr", "patchwork"))
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## The Formula API

cliomicplot uses `y ~ x | group` — the same convention you already know.

| Formula                      | What it does                       |
|------------------------------|------------------------------------|
| `y ~ x`                      | y vs. x (scatter/line)             |
| `y ~ x \| group`             | Grouped, auto-legend, auto-palette |
| `~ x \| group`               | One-sided distributional plot      |
| `Surv(time, status) ~ group` | Kaplan-Meier survival              |
| `HR ~ Variable \| Subgroup`  | Forest plot                        |

**All arguments in one call:**

| Argument | Purpose | Example |
|----|----|----|
| `type` | Plot type | `"boxplot"`, `type_km(risk_table = TRUE)` |
| `palette` | Color palette | `"jco"`, `"nejm"`, `"cosmic"` |
| `theme` | Theme | `"nature"`, `"dark"`, `"broadsheet"` |
| `facet` | Faceting formula | `facet = ~ dose` |
| `stat.test` | Statistical test | `"wilcox.test"`, `"anova"` |
| `file` | Save to file | `"figure1.pdf"` |
| `width`, `height` | Output dimensions | `width = 8`, `height = 6` |

### Global Defaults: `clipar()`

Set defaults for all plots — like
[`par()`](https://rdrr.io/r/graphics/par.html) for base R:

``` r

clipar(palette.qualitative = "nejm", stat.test = "wilcox.test",
       file.width = 8, file.height = 6, file.res = 600)

clipar("palette.qualitative")  # query a single parameter
# [1] "nejm"
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Gallery

Every figure is a single
[`cliplot()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cliplot.md)
call. Click any image to enlarge.

### Clinical Oncology — 7 Lines of Code

``` r

library(cliomicplot)
library(survival)
clitheme("nejm")

# 1. Kaplan-Meier survival with risk table
cliplot(Surv(time, status) ~ sex, data = lung,
        type = type_km(risk_table = TRUE, pval = TRUE, conf_int = TRUE))

# 2. Forest plot from Cox model
cliplot(HR ~ Variable, data = cox_results, type = "forest")

# 3. Waterfall — tumor response
cliplot(BestChange ~ Patient, data = imtrial,
        type = type_waterfall(show_labels = TRUE))

# 4. Swimmer — patient timelines
cliplot(Duration ~ Patient, data = imtrial,
        type = type_swimmer(bar_fill = "BestResp", event_times = events_df))
```

|  |  |  |  |
|:--:|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| **Kaplan-Meier** | **Forest Plot** | **Waterfall** | **Swimmer** |
| [![KM](reference/figures/km.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/km.png) | [![Forest](reference/figures/forest.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/forest.png) | [![Waterfall](reference/figures/waterfall.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/waterfall.png) | [![Swimmer](reference/figures/swimmer.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/swimmer.png) |

### Clinical Trials & Cohort Studies (Journal Archetypes)

New clinical visualization archetypes adhering to Nature, Cell, and
Science reporting standards and real-world clinical cohort figures:

``` r

# 1. Minimal Clinically Important Difference (MCID) Dumbbell (Archetype 1)
# Compare observed effect sizes vs validated MCID threshold
cliplot(Estimate ~ Endpoint, data = mcid_df,
        type = type_mcid(mcid = "MCID", n_treated = "N"))

# 2. Longitudinal Trajectory with Clinical Severity Bands (Archetype 4)
# Spaghetti paths + bold mixed-model mean + shaded Mild/Moderate/Severe bands
cliplot(Score ~ Visit | Patient, data = longitudinal_df,
        type = type_trajectory(show_mean = TRUE, show_n = TRUE))

# 3. Kaplan-Meier with Cumulative Incidence & Landmark Milestones (Archetype 5)
# Zero external dependencies; exact percentages at 6mo, 1y, 2y callouts
cliplot(Surv(time, status) ~ sex, data = lung,
        type = type_km(cumulative_incidence = TRUE, milestones = c(180, 365, 730)))

# 4. Swimmer Plot with Ongoing Indicators (Archetype 13)
# Ongoing therapy arrowheads at bar ends + RECIST event milestones
cliplot(Duration ~ Patient, data = pt_data,
        type = type_swimmer(bar_fill = "Response", ongoing = "Ongoing", event_times = events))

# 5. Forest Plot with Alternating Stripes & Pooled Diamonds (Archetype 9)
# Subtle row striping eliminates eye drift across wide canvases
cliplot(HR ~ Variable, data = meta_df,
        type = type_forest(stripe = TRUE, diamond = TRUE, show_values = TRUE))
```

### Multi-Omics — Differential Expression in 3 Lines

``` r

# Volcano plot (y ~ x: significance ~ fold-change)
cliplot(-log10(padj) ~ logFC, data = deg_results,
        type = type_volcano(label_genes = "significant"))

# MA plot with LOESS smoothing
cliplot(logFC ~ baseMean, data = deg_results, type = "ma")

# Correlation heatmap
cliplot(expression_matrix, type = type_correlation(method = "spearman"))
```

|  |  |  |
|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| **Volcano** | **MA Plot** | **Correlation** |
| [![volcano](reference/figures/volcano.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/volcano.png) | [![MA](reference/figures/ma.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/ma.png) | [![Correlation](reference/figures/correlation.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/correlation.png) |
| **Heatmap** | **PCA** |  |
| [![heatmap](reference/figures/heatmap.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/heatmap.png) | [![PCA](reference/figures/pca.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/pca.png) |  |

### Recreating a Published Paper (Soares et al. 2025, *Biology of Sex Differences*)

The main figures of a real publication - “X-linked transcriptome
dysregulation across immune cells in systemic lupus erythematosus” (DOI:
`10.1186/s13293-025-00750-3`) - were recreated from the paper’s own
supplementary tables (bundled in `inst/extdata/sle_paper/`), rendered at
300 dpi in Nature style. See
[`vignette("recreate-paper")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/recreate-paper.md)
and `inst/extdata/build_sle_figures.R`.

|  |  |  |
|:--:|:--:|:--:|
| **Fig. 1: X-linked dysregulation** | **Fig. 2: DIABLO classification** | **Fig. 3: XIST dysregulation** |
| [![SLE Fig 1](reference/figures/sle_fig1.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/sle_fig1.png) | [![SLE Fig 2](reference/figures/sle_fig2.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/sle_fig2.png) | [![SLE Fig 3](reference/figures/sle_fig3.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/sle_fig3.png) |
| **Fig. 4: XIST interactome** |  |  |
| [![SLE Fig 4](reference/figures/sle_fig4.png)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/man/figures/sle_fig4.png) |  |  |

Plot types used: `type_boxplot`, `type_volcano`, `type_heatmap`,
`type_barplot` + `patchwork` composites.

## Themes — Publication Ready

11 built-in themes. One function call.

``` r

clitheme("nature")     # persistent theme for all subsequent plots
cliplot(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars)
clitheme()             # reset to default
```

Or per-plot:

``` r

cliplot(mpg ~ wt, data = mtcars, theme = "dark")
```

| Theme | Style | Journal / Use |
|----|----|----|
| `cli_bw` | Clean black-and-white | Default |
| `cli_classic` | Classic with axis lines | Base R aesthetic |
| `cli_minimal` | Minimalist | Modern general use |
| `nature` | Nature Publishing Group | Nature journals |
| `science` | Science / AAAS | *Science* |
| `nejm` | NEJM | *New England Journal of Medicine* |
| `lancet` | The Lancet | *The Lancet* |
| `cell` | Cell Press | *Cell* and family |
| `broadsheet` | Print-optimized with subtle grid | General publication |
| `showcase` | Polished presentation | Slides, posters |
| `dark` | Dark background | Talks, dashboards |

Register custom themes with
`clitheme_register("mytheme", base = "cli_bw", ...)`.

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Color Palettes

55+ built-in palettes. Discrete, sequential, diverging, and
journal-specific.

``` r

cli_palette_list()               # see all names
cli_palette_show("cosmic")       # preview a palette

# In plots
cliplot(mpg ~ wt | cyl, data = mtcars, palette = "npg")

# Standalone ggplot2 scales
ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Petal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  palette_scale("jama", "color")
```

| Category | Palettes |
|----|----|
| Journals | `jco`, `nejm`, `lancet`, `npg`, `jama`, `bmj`, `frontiers` |
| Genomics | `ucscgb`, `igv`, `locuszoom`, `cosmic`, `cosmic_sig`, `gsea`, `volcano` |
| Accessibility | `okabe_ito`, `tableau10`, `tol_muted` |
| D3 / Web | `d3_category10`, `d3_category20`, `flatui`, `material`, `bs5` |
| Sequential | `blues`, `reds`, `greens`, `purples`, `oranges` |
| Diverging | `heatmap_rdbu`, `heatmap_rdylbu`, `heatmap_prgn`, `rd_yl_gn`, `spectral`, `pi_yg` |
| Dark | `neon`, `cyberpunk` |
| Soft | `pastel`, `soft` |
| Sci-fi | `futurama`, `rickandmorty`, `simpsons`, `startrek` |

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Markdown Text

Rich text in titles and labels with
[`cli_markdown()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_markdown.md):

``` r

cliplot(len ~ dose, data = ToothGrowth, type = "boxplot",
        title = "**Tooth Length** by Vitamin C Dose",
        subtitle = "*p* &lt; 0.05 for all pairwise comparisons",
        ylab = "Length (mm)") +
  cli_markdown()
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## For Standalone ggplot2 Use

Use
[`palette_scale()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/palette_scale.md)
to drop cliomicplot palettes into any ggplot:

``` r

library(ggplot2)
ggplot(iris, aes(Sepal.Length, Petal.Length, color = Species)) +
  geom_point() +
  palette_scale("cosmic", "color")

# Continuous palettes too
ggplot(faithfuld, aes(waiting, eruptions, fill = density)) +
  geom_tile() +
  palette_scale("heatmap_rdbu", "fill", type = "continuous")
```

------------------------------------------------------------------------

## Vignettes

Organized into 5 logical parts matching the online handbook [Clinical
and Omics Data Visualization in
R](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot_book/):

- **Part I: Graphic Grammar & Design System**:
  - [`vignette("cliomicplot")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/cliomicplot.md)
    — Core grammar, constructor functions, and layer composition
  - [`vignette("themes-palettes")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/themes-palettes.md)
    — 13 journal themes and CVD-safe color palettes
  - [`vignette("journal-plots")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/journal-plots.md)
    — Journal trim sizing (`cli_journal_size`) and
    [`cli_scifig_qa()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_scifig_qa.md)
    compliance gate
- **Part II: Clinical Trials & Survival Analysis**:
  - [`vignette("oncology")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/oncology.md)
    — Kaplan-Meier milestones, Cox forest plots, RECIST waterfall,
    swimmer timelines, and MCID
- **Part III: High-Dimensional Omics Visualizations**:
  - [`vignette("volcano-plot")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/volcano-plot.md)
    — Differential expression volcano plots with NCBI GEO GSE121212
  - [`vignette("multiomics")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/multiomics.md)
    — Translational proteomics, GSEA cascades, and diamond bubble
    heatmaps
  - [`vignette("microbiome-mgwas")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/microbiome-mgwas.md)
    — Cutaneous metagenomics, host *FLG* genetics, mGWAS, and dyad
    strain sharing
- **Part IV: Systems Biology & Coupled Multi-Network Architectures**:
  - [`vignette("coupled-networks")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/coupled-networks.md)
    — Cross-condition networks, 4 topological styles, 4-corner
    environmental heatmaps, and preservation testing
- **Part V: Publication Composites & Applied Case Studies**:
  - [`vignette("case-study-atopic-dermatitis")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/case-study-atopic-dermatitis.md)
    — Translational multi-omics case study in atopic dermatitis
  - [`vignette("case-study-cancer-immunotherapy")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/case-study-cancer-immunotherapy.md)
    — Immuno-oncology clinical trial endpoint reporting
  - [`vignette("recreate-paper")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/recreate-paper.md)
    — Published paper reproduction: SLE X-chromosome dysregulation
    (Soares et al., *Biol Sex Differ* 2025)
  - [`vignette("recreate-nature-communications-polyps")`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/recreate-nature-communications-polyps.md)
    — Published paper reproduction: Granzyme K+ CD8+ T cells in nasal
    polyps and cross-tissue chronic inflammation (Sun et al., *Nat
    Commun* 2024)

# Package index

## Core engine

The main plotting function and layer helpers.

- [`cliplot()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cliplot.md)
  : Publication-Ready Plots for Clinical and Multi-Omics Data
- [`cliplot_add()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cliplot_add.md)
  : Add Layers to an Existing Cliomicplot
- [`cliplot_interactive()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cliplot_interactive.md)
  : Interactive Plot Mode
- [`cli_markdown()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_markdown.md)
  : Enable Markdown Rendering in Plot Text Elements

## Themes & parameters

- [`clitheme()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/clitheme.md)
  : Set or Reset Plot Themes for cliomicplot
- [`theme_cli_benchmark()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_benchmark.md)
  : Benchmark & Multi-Omics Figure Theme
- [`theme_cli_broadsheet()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_broadsheet.md)
  : Broadsheet Publication Print Theme
- [`theme_cli_bw()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_bw.md)
  : Standard Black-and-White Theme for Laboratory Exploration
- [`theme_cli_cell()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_cell.md)
  : Cell Press Theme
- [`theme_cli_classic()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_classic.md)
  : Classic Axis Theme
- [`theme_cli_dark()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_dark.md)
  : Dark Background Theme for Slides & Keynotes
- [`theme_cli_ecology()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_ecology.md)
  : Ecology / Demographic Viability Theme
- [`theme_cli_lancet()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_lancet.md)
  : The Lancet Theme
- [`theme_cli_minimal()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_minimal.md)
  : Minimal Clean Theme
- [`theme_cli_nature()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_nature.md)
  : Nature Publishing Group Theme
- [`theme_cli_nejm()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_nejm.md)
  : New England Journal of Medicine (NEJM) Theme
- [`theme_cli_pathology()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_pathology.md)
  : Nature Pathology Boxplot Theme
- [`theme_cli_science()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_science.md)
  : Science Magazine Theme
- [`theme_cli_scifig()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_scifig.md)
  : SCI Full-Box Scientific Figure Theme
- [`theme_cli_showcase()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/theme_cli_showcase.md)
  : Showcase Theme for High-Contrast Posters & Hero Figures
- [`clipar()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/clipar.md)
  : Set or Query Cliomicplot Graphical Parameters
- [`clitheme_list()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/clitheme_list.md)
  : List Available Themes
- [`clitheme_md()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/clitheme_md.md)
  : Enable Markdown Globally for the Active Theme
- [`clitheme_md_reset()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/clitheme_md_reset.md)
  : Disable Global Markdown Rendering
- [`clitheme_register()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/clitheme_register.md)
  : Register a Custom Theme
- [`clitheme_unregister()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/clitheme_unregister.md)
  : Unregister a Custom Theme

## Publication helpers

- [`cli_panel_label()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_panel_label.md)
  : Add a Panel Label (A, B, C ...) to a ggplot
- [`cli_legend_out()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_legend_out.md)
  : Move the Legend Outside the Plot
- [`cli_save()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_save.md)
  : Save a Figure at Journal-Reference Dimensions
- [`cli_journal_size()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_journal_size.md)
  : Get Exact Figure Dimensions for Specific Scientific Journals
- [`cli_scifig_qa()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_scifig_qa.md)
  : SciFig Quality Assurance and Journal Compliance Audit

## Palettes

- [`cli_palette_list()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_palette_list.md)
  : List Available Cliomicplot Palettes
- [`cli_palette_show()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_palette_show.md)
  : Show a Cliomicplot Palette
- [`palette_scale()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/palette_scale.md)
  [`scale_color_cli()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/palette_scale.md)
  [`scale_fill_cli()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/palette_scale.md)
  [`scale_color_cli_c()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/palette_scale.md)
  [`scale_fill_cli_c()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/palette_scale.md)
  : Build a ggplot2 Scale from a Cliomicplot Palette
- [`gradient_pal()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/gradient_pal.md)
  : Generate a smooth color gradient

## Datasets

Curated clinical cohorts and multi-omics reference datasets.

  : Cis-pQTL Mendelian Randomization and Colocalization Results
- [`immune_cell_composition`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/immune_cell_composition.md)
  : Single-Cell Immune Lineage Composition Across Blood Libraries

## Systems Biology & Microbial Networks

- [`cliplot_cross_network_graph()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cliplot_cross_network_graph.md)
  : Direct Cross-Network Architecture Plotting Function
- [`type_cross_network_graph()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_cross_network_graph.md)
  : Multi-Group Cross-Network Architecture Graph
- [`cliplot_env_network()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cliplot_env_network.md)
  : Direct Plotting Function for Modular Network with Environmental
  Factor Heatmaps
- [`type_env_network()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_env_network.md)
  : Circular Modular Network Coupled with Environmental Correlation
  Heatmaps
- [`calc_zipi()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/calc_zipi.md)
  : Compute Zi (Within-Module Connectivity) and Pi (Participation
  Coefficient)
- [`type_zipi()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_zipi.md)
  : Zi-Pi Keystone Ecological Role Plot Type
- [`type_mantel_triangle()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_mantel_triangle.md)
  : Triangular Correlation Heatmap with Curved Mantel Links
- [`type_polygon_network()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_polygon_network.md)
  : Modular Polygon Ring Network Plot Type
- [`type_bipartite()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_bipartite.md)
  : Transkingdom & Multi-Omics Bipartite Network Type
- [`type_edge_dynamics()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_edge_dynamics.md)
  : Ecological Network Edge-Sign Dynamics Plot Type
- [`cli_calc_env_links()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_calc_env_links.md)
  : Automated Calculation of Empirical Omics-to-Environment Links
- [`cli_network_permutation()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_network_permutation.md)
  : Permutation Significance Testing for Cross-Network Structural
  Differences
- [`type_module_compare()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_module_compare.md)
  : Cross-Network Module Comparison Heatmap
- [`type_module_trait()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_module_trait.md)
  : Module-Trait and Environmental Factor Correlation Heatmap
- [`cli_module_preservation()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_module_preservation.md)
  : Evaluate Cross-Network Module Preservation Statistics
- [`type_module_preservation()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_module_preservation.md)
  : Cross-Network Module Preservation Plot Type
- [`cliplot_module_preservation()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cliplot_module_preservation.md)
  : Standalone Module Preservation Figure
- [`cli_network_robustness()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_network_robustness.md)
  : Simulate Multi-Network Robustness Under Random and Targeted Node
  Attacks
- [`type_network_robustness()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/type_network_robustness.md)
  : Network Robustness Degradation Curves Plot Type
- [`cliplot_network_robustness()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cliplot_network_robustness.md)
  : Standalone Network Robustness Plot
- [`cli_mantel()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_mantel.md)
  : Mantel and Partial Mantel Test for Omics-Environment Associations
- [`cli_partial_cor()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_partial_cor.md)
  : Partial Correlation with Covariate Adjustment
- [`cli_module_summary()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_module_summary.md)
  : Calculate Module Eigengenes and Composite Scores
- [`cli_network_rewiring()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_network_rewiring.md)
  : Differential Network Rewiring and Edge Conservation Analysis
- [`generate_demo_cross_network()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/generate_demo_cross_network.md)
  : Generate Demonstration Dataset for Cross-Network Architecture
- [`cli_demo_vitality_multiomics()`](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/reference/cli_demo_vitality_multiomics.md)
  : Generate Synthetic Multi-Network Multi-Omics Dataset

# Articles

### Part I — Graphic Grammar and Design System

Core grammar, layer composition, journal typography, trim sizing, and
SciFig quality assurance.

- [Getting Started with
  cliomicplot](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/cliomicplot.md):
- [Themes and Palettes in
  cliomicplot](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/themes-palettes.md):
- [Nature/Cell/Science-Quality Figures with
  cliomicplot](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/journal-plots.md):

### Part II — Clinical Trials and Survival Analysis

Time-to-event milestones, multivariable forest plots, RECIST tumor
waterfall, swimmer timelines, and MCID effect sizes.

- [Clinical Trials, Survival Analysis, and Oncology
  Trajectories](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/oncology.md):

### Part III — High-Dimensional Omics Visualizations

Differential expression, multi-contrast volcano plots, translational
proteomics, pathway enrichment, microbial GWAS, and dyad strain sharing.

- [Differential Expression Volcano Plots with GEO
  Datasets](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/volcano-plot.md):
- [Translational Proteomics and Functional Pathway
  Enrichment](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/multiomics.md):
- [Microbial Metagenomics and mGWAS in Clinical
  Cohorts](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/microbiome-mgwas.md):

### Part IV — Systems Biology and Coupled Multi-Network Architectures

Cross-condition network modularity, topological layout styles, coupled
environmental heatmaps, module preservation, and permutation testing.

- [Coupled Environmental Networks and Multi-Network
  Architectures](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/coupled-networks.md):

### Part V — Publication Composites and Applied Case Studies

Complete translational case studies in atopic dermatitis and
immuno-oncology, and published paper reproductions.

- [Case Study: Biomarker Stratification and Dysbiosis in Atopic
  Dermatitis](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/case-study-atopic-dermatitis.md):
- [Case Study: Immuno-Oncology Biomarkers and Trial
  Endpoints](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/case-study-cancer-immunotherapy.md):
- [Recreating a Published Figure: SLE X-Chromosome
  Dysregulation](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/recreate-paper.md):
- [Recreating Multi-Modal Figures: Nature Communications (Nasal
  Polyps)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/recreate-nature-communications-polyps.md):
- [Multi-Omics Reproduction & Audit: Nature Metabolism
  (Nanoplastics)](https://vanhungtran.github.io/cliomicplot/articles/reproduce-nature-metabolism-microplastics.md):
